statement: Build the Polyintelligence Seed Genome v0.1 (the Competency Compiler seed) in GitHub as a reviewable, consequence-inert pull request on the Kernel: universal ProblemGeometry, CognitiveCapabilityProfile, EpistemicClass, ProofClass, ConsequenceVector, CognitiveReceipt, ABSTAIN, a deterministic eligibility router, Semantic, Fermi, Formal/Optimization and Evidence/Causal organs, an independent Adversarial Gatekeeper, the translation/reverse-translation/counterexample protocol, a baseline comparison, a geometry-specific competency ledger, and hooks for later cognition classes without implementing them; keep MICA/CDPE outside the production proof; keep VEPMC 0->1 as GREG's device proof; converge rather than duplicate the existing lineages.
source_refs: docs/intent/sources/POLYINTELLIGENCE-CORTEX-REVIEW-PASS-1-2026-09-30.md and -PASS-2-2026-09-30.md (the review the founder re-sent with 'Build this')
docs/intent/sources/POLYINTELLIGENCE-CORTEX-BUILD-DIRECTIVE-SEED-GENOME-2026-10-01.md section 0 (the four quoted paragraphs and the translation rules)
This source records founder expression and does not authenticate a runtime principal; repetition creates no additional authority
owner: Alfonso Lopez; Kernel cognition maintainers implement
binding_scope: The cortex package and its contracts, the standing-runtime binding, the evaluation harness and its evidence, and the registry of competing cognition lineages. Draft development on a branch; no activation, no promotion, no external effect.
constitutional_constraints: Cognition proposes; it never authorizes. Every receipt and candidate carries authority_created false and execution_authority none
The cortex imports no Gate, adapter or actuator; external effects continue through policy -> grant -> Consequence Gate
Competence settles only on verified outcomes and can reorder eligible routes only; it cannot add a route, enable a family, change a ceiling or touch permissions

'meniscus' = frontier of the verified envelope; 'impermeable shield' = layered prevention, bounded failure, independent verification, recoverability, demonstrated attack resistance; 'systemic dominance' = superior lawful capability, accepted proof, reliable service, reusable assets, participant benefit, durable optionality. None licenses control over people, resistance to shutdown or promises of perfection
A frontier-model baseline served from a transcript is a record of replies, never a simulation; its provenance replaces the harness's local-model disclosure
One authority, many governed capabilities: competing lineages are registered and preserved, never deleted; merging any of them is a founder decision
success_evidence: tests/unit/test_cortex_defect_fixes.py (four 0.1.5 defects reproduced and fixed in 0.1.6, plus D5: a declared harm vector may raise the consequence class, ported from the #143 lineage)
tests/unit/test_cortex_finality_deficit.py (the named Epistemic Finality Rule cited by every receipt; abstention emits a typed CapabilityDeficit that authorizes nothing)
tests/unit/test_cortex_proposer.py (cortex bound to StandingCognitionRuntime; receipts ledgered; abstain/handoff/recommend paths; no actuator import)
tests/unit/test_cortex_replay.py (frozen arms from a transcript; missing replies are errors, not guesses; freeze untouched)
tests/unit/test_cognition_lineages.py (every lineage registered with a disposition that creates no authority)

tests/evidence/cortex-seed-v0.1.6/ (frozen held-out run with the declared baselines served from the recorded frontier-model transcript; verdict GAIN_ABSENT as computed by the unchanged exit rule; routed 1.000, 0 critical errors; always_llm 0.905, 2; llm_committee 0.929, 1)
scripts/ci/check_cortex_mutants.py 43/43 caught on 0.1.6 by behavioural tests (freeze-hash checks deselected); the full Kernel suite and CI guard scripts green on the branch
failure_evidence: No real outcome has settled competence; the CompetenceLedger has only synthetic settlements (learning_checks)
The held-out suite is self-authored and structured-only (42 items, six geometry groups with n>=3); a free-text, externally authored suite does not exist
The semantic organ has never run against a live local model; in the reported run it was served by a recorded transcript of the baseline model (frontier-model-A)

The baseline transcript was produced by sibling agents of the same frontier model family under an instruction not to use tools; the audit is post hoc (transcript inspection), not a runtime restriction
The fourteen lineages that carry #137 cannot be merged to main until #137 is decided; their mechanisms are queued, not ported
VEPMC remains 0: nothing here runs on the founder's Chromebook

The frozen held-out verdict is GAIN_ABSENT: the routed seed scored 1.000 with no critical error against 0.905 and 0.929, but the paired-gain lower bounds (0.024, 0.000) did not clear the frozen 0.05 threshold on 42 self-authored items

Report kill condition 1 applies (2026-10-14): with the baselines run and the exit GAIN_ABSENT, the router is not a performance claim; the safety layer stays on an observed, unestablished critical-error advantage (exact one-sided McNemar p = 0.125 for harmful failures). At 42 items the frozen rule had 10% and 3% power for the observed gains (tests/evidence/cortex-seed-v0.1.6/power-analysis.json)
dependencies: capabilities.genome (KNOWN_CONTRACTS carries the five cortex contract names), memory.causal.VALIDATION_WEIGHT, provenance.ledger.EvidenceLedger, egregore.runtime.StandingCognitionRuntime
z3-solver (requirements-cortex.txt) for the Formal organ and the held-out run
A founder decision on PR #137 before any stacked lineage can be converged
A founder-selected local model before the semantic organ or a local always-LLM arm can be measured
conflicts: The review's 'Keep VEPMC 0->1 as GREG's current global bottleneck' versus the 2026-10-02 full-machine completion correction ('earlier global VEPMC pauses are superseded'): resolved here as the correction states, VEPMC stays the required device proof and the primary node, and does not pause buildable software

Sixteen open draft lineages implement overlapping seeds (thirteen when this work began; #161-#163 opened the same day); this branch productizes the main-compatible #141 and registers the rest instead of adding a fourteenth silo
The review's five-layer naming (L1-L5) versus the build prompt's five layers: both preserved through REVIEW_LAYER_MAP, unchanged here
next_review_trigger: Founder review of the draft PR; or the first real outcome settled through the standing-runtime binding; or a founder-selected local model that unlocks the local baseline arms and the semantic organ; or a founder choice of the 0.1.7 primary endpoint (frozen quality rule on about 1,045 externally authored items, or harmful-failure rate on at least 93 to 144), fixed before any baseline reply is collected.
